rubrics.justification: Describes a high-quality blastocyst with plausible ICM and TE features and notes image limitations, but shows confusion about Gardner staging (4AA vs hatching stage 5/6) and makes some uncertain claims about herniation not firmly supported.

Integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, prior miscarriage, sperm parameters, and especially thin endometrium into prognosis; could be stronger on how fresh transfer context and tubal pathology specifically modify embryo-level expectations.

The response contains notable internal contradictions, especially around implantation estimates (variously 55-70%, 45-55%, 25-35%, 30-50%, 30-45%) and stage interpretation, which weakens the logic chain despite a reasonable final summary.

Mostly consistent with IVF practice on SET, morphology limits, and concern for thin lining/hydrosalpinx, but staging confusion and somewhat inconsistent statements about PGT-A and transfer timing reduce alignment with standard Gardner/clinical guidance.

Provides practical recommendations on SET, luteal support, hydrosalpinx evaluation, lifestyle adjustment, and considering freeze-all/FET if lining is suboptimal; useful though not highly specific on thresholds or protocol details.
